info.title: Evervault API
info.description: The Evervault API allows developers to interact programmatically with their Evervault apps using HTTP requests.

tags.name: Insights
tags.description: The Evervault API provides several endpoints which can be used to retrieve additional information for cards and bin ranges. This can be used for tasks such as fraud detection and payment routing.

tags.name: 3D Secure
tags.description: 3D Secure is a security protocol designed to prevent fraud in online card transactions. It adds an additional layer of authentication during the payment process.

tags.name: Card Account Updates
tags.description: If your account has access to [Card Account Updater](/cards/card-account-updater) you can use the Card Account Updater API to register cards for automatic updates. If an update is available for a card, the `replacement` field will be populated with the identifier of the new card.

tags.name: Real-time Account Updater
tags.description: The Real-time Account Updater API lets you pull the latest details for a card on request, or have Evervault push updates to you as they happen. Submit a card number to the [Checks](/cards/real-time-account-updater) endpoint for a synchronous result, or to the [Subscriptions](/cards/real-time-account-updater) endpoint and Evervault delivers updates to your registered webhook as the card networks push them.

tags.name: Acquirers
tags.description: The Acquirer API allows you to enroll Acquirer details with Card Networks to enable use of other payment APIs such as [3D Secure](#3d-secure).

tags.name: Intelligent Retries
tags.description: The Intelligent Retries API allows you to manage Intelligent Retries enrolments for a merchant.

tags.name: Pre-Chargeback Alerts
tags.description:
Pre-chargeback alerts notify you when a cardholder raises a dispute with their issuer,
giving you a window to resolve it before it escalates to a formal chargeback. Configure
enrolments via the [Merchants API](#merchants), then retrieve and respond to alerts here.
See the [Pre-Chargeback Alerts guide](/cards/pre-chargeback-alerts) for an overview.

tags.name: Relays
tags.description: Relay is a network proxy that can be configured to encrypt or decrypt sensitive data as it passes between a client and a destination server. Relay can be used with your own API or with third-party APIs. It is designed to be easy to use and requires minimal changes to your existing code.

tags.name: Functions
tags.description: Evervault [Functions](/functions) are secure serverless functions which allow you to process data encrypted by Evervault products. When you pass encrypted data to a Function, it is automatically decrypted. You can then process this data by running custom logic written in Node.js or Python as you usually would, but without ever handling it in plaintext on your infrastructure.

tags.name: Client Tokens
tags.description: Client-Side Tokens are short-lived tokens that can be used to perform actions from your frontend applications.

The Card Insights API allows you to perform address verification (AVS), name verification (ANI), CVV, email, and phone verification checks. You can also check the card's push and pull transaction capabilities and retrieve the Payment Account Reference (PAR).

post.description:
When registering a card, you can provide either an Evervault encrypted card number or a plaintext card number. If you provide a plaintext card number it will be encrypted and the encrypted value will be returned in the response.

Card registration is idempotent on card number. Registering the same card number a second time returns the existing Card object, rather than creating a new one. This means you can use the Card object `id` as a unique identifier. If you register an existing card number but with a different expiry date, the existing Card object is updated with the new date, and Evervault returns a `200 OK` response. A `201 Created` response indicates that a new Card object was created.

post.summary: Subscribe a card for real-time account updates
post.description:
Provide an Evervault encrypted or
plaintext card number and expiry, and Evervault registers the card with the card
networks. When an issuer pushes an update, Evervault delivers a
[`real-time.card.updated`](/api#realTimeCardUpdated) webhook.

Only Visa and Mastercard cards are supported. A card of any other brand is
rejected with a `400` status code before the subscription is created.

The response confirms the subscription only; it doesn't return card details. Every

configuration (Ethoca descriptors, Verifi BIN/CAID, and so on) is not included —
retrieve the merchant via the Merchants API if you need the full enrolment details.
